title: Order instructions for the build cache
statement: A Node.js project changes its source files often but its package.json and package-lock.json rarely. Which Dockerfile body (after FROM node:22-slim and WORKDIR /app) lets the next build reuse the cached `npm ci` layer when only source files changed?
choices:
COPY . .
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci

COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY . .
